target.title: fix(channels): retain draft preview id after failed delete for retry (#104865)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Discord partial streaming forgets the preview message ID after a cleanup DELETE failure, leaving a stale preview beside the fresh final reply with no way to retry the cleanup.

Closes #104865.

## Why This Change Was Made

`clearFinalizableDraftMessage` called `takeMessageIdAfterStop`, which cleared the stored preview ID **before** attempting the DELETE call. If the DELETE failed (e.g., Discord returns HTTP 500), the ID was already forgotten, so no later cleanup call could retry it.

This change moves the ID clear to **after** a successful DELETE, with a compare-and-clear guard: the ID is only cleared if the stored ID still matches the one that was just deleted, preventing accidental erasure of a newer preview that replaced it while the DELETE was in flight.

## User Impact

Discord users with partial streaming enabled: a transient DELETE failure no longer leaves an unrecoverable stale preview. The preview ID survives the failed cleanup and can be retried by a subsequent cleanup call. The existing `onDeleteSuccess` callback and successful cleanup behavior are unchanged.

Mattermost users also benefit from the same compare-and-clear safety since they share this shared helper.

## Evidence

- `pnpm test src/channels/draft-stream-controls.test.ts` — **8/8 passed** (7 existing + 1 new)
  - New: `clearFinalizableDraftMessage retains the id after a failed delete for retry` — proves ID survives first failed DELETE and clears after second successful DELETE
  - All existing tests pass unchanged
